name: EyeBench-V2
description: Over the past decade, generative models have demonstrated success in enhancing fundus images. However, the evaluation of these models remains a challenge. A benchmark for fundus image enhancement is needed for three main reasons:(1) Conventional denoising metrics such as PSNR and SSIM fail to capture clinically relevant features, such as lesion preservation and vessel morphology consistency, limiting their applicability in real-world settings; (2) There is a lack of unified evaluation protocols that address both paired and unpaired enhancement methods, particularly those guided by clinical exp…
